# HomeServe — On-Demand Home Services Booking SaaS Platform

> HomeServe is a full-stack on-demand home maintenance SaaS platform designed to connect homeowners with verified local service professionals across India. The ecosystem features four role-based portals (Customer, Service Provider, Technician, and Super Admin) with integrated Razorpay digital payments, 21 relational database entities, and real-time status dispatch tracking.

---

## 1. Core Platform Capabilities
- **On-Demand Dispatch**: Book electricians, plumbers, AC technicians, house cleaners, and carpenters delivered within 45 to 60 minutes.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Fixed upfront pricing with zero hidden surcharges and 30-day post-service warranty.
- **Verified Professionals**: 100% background-checked, KYC-verified technicians with trade skill certifications.
- **Secure Online Checkout**: Razorpay test-mode integration supporting UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Debit/Credit cards, and Net Banking with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
- **4 Role-Based Dashboards**:
  - Customer: Browse catalog, schedule visits, track orders, pay online, write reviews.
  - Service Provider: Manage catalog, assign technicians, review earnings.
  - Technician: View daily field itinerary, navigate to premises, update job status (`Assigned` -> `In Progress` -> `Completed`).
  - Super Admin: Platform GMV metrics, user management, provider KYC verification, security audit logs.

---

## 3. Technology Stack & Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, Axios, React Router v6.
- **Backend API**: Python 3.11, FastAPI v1, Uvicorn, Starlette, Pydantic v2.
- **ORM & Database**: SQLAlchemy 2.0, Alembic Migrations, 21 Relational Tables (SQLite / Cloud MySQL).
- **Interactive API Documentation**: https://vibe-coding-com-sanket-mdmm.onrender.com/docs
- **Code Repository**: https://github.com/SanketTOPS/Vibe_Coding_Com_Sanket

---

## 4. Primary API Endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/categories/`: List active home service categories.
- `GET /api/v1/services/`: Search and filter catalog services with price units and provider details.
- `GET /api/v1/services/{id}`: Detailed service specifications, reviews, and provider ratings.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/register`: New user registration with password encryption.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login`: Issue JWT HS256 access and refresh tokens.
- `POST /api/v1/bookings/`: Create service appointment.
- `POST /api/v1/payments/create-order`: Generate authentic Razorpay order ID.
- `POST /api/v1/payments/verify`: Cryptographically verify payment signatures via HMAC-SHA256.
